title: Why carry the leaf?
hook: Some ants bring leaves into a hidden chamber.

knows: Fungi can grow on organic material.
doesNotKnow: Connect leaf collection with fungus cultivation.

misconception: Leafcutter ants collect leaves only to eat them directly.
objective: Connect leaf collection with fungus cultivation.

claims.text: Some ants bring leaves into a hidden chamber. In a leafcutter-ant colony, what is a major use of the cut leaves brought to the garden? The illustration shows cut leaves added to a fungus garden. Leafcutter ants cultivate fungus on prepared plant material, and the fungus supplies food to the colony. The diagram simplifies a complex partnership.
